title: Trump pushes Apple to change 'Lake Ontario' to 'Lake America' on its maps
summary_full: The request comes after Google made the switch for US-based users over the weekend. MapQuest, another US map provider, said it will not change the name.
summary_public: The request comes after Google made the switch for US-based users over the weekend. MapQuest, another US map provider, said it will not change the name.
